items.title: PlanRefs on the ActionPlan and the working_refs library
items.action: Copy the planned test file docs/plans/2025/tests/tests/lib/test_working_refs.py to tests/lib/test_working_refs.py first. (1) plan_models.py: add a closed `PlanRefs` model (`todo_ids: List[str]`, `issues: List[int]`, each default empty) and `refs: Optional[PlanRefs] = None` on ActionPlan after `base_branch`. Not Mutable; plan_dict dumps with exclude_unset, so a plan without refs (every frozen plan) keeps its digest. Regenerate the schema with `python tools/gen_plan_schema.py`. (2) New plugins/harness/lib/harness_lib/working_refs.py: OVERRIDES_REL = 'working-refs/overrides.json', LINE_REL = 'working-refs/line.txt', STORE_VERSION = 1, DETACHED = '(detached)'; WorkingRefsError(ValueError); parse_refs(tokens) splits each token on commas and whitespace, reads '#N' or all digits as an issue int, else todo_sync.ids.canonical, else raises; duplicates dropped, first order kept. fill_issues(refs, catalog) returns refs unchanged when it names an issue, else the union of the named ids' catalog gh_issues in id order. read_overrides(path) -> Dict[str, PlanRefs] ({} for an absent file; WorkingRefsError for a file that is not a version-1 object). set_override(path, branch, refs) writes {version, branches: {branch: {todo_ids, issues, set_at (UTC ISO, Z)}}} through a sibling temp file and os.replace (add_note.py write_notes pattern); clear_override(path, branch) -> bool. format_refs(refs) -> 'todo-k69m (301)', ids joined ', ' then issues in parentheses joined ', '; issues alone as '#301, #315'. Each function under 50 lines, Optional/Union only.

items.title: plan.py new --refs
items.action: Copy the planned test file docs/plans/2025/tests/tests/scripts/test_plan_new_refs.py to tests/scripts/test_plan_new_refs.py first. plan.py: `new` gains `--refs` (help: comma- or space-separated TODO ids and issue numbers, e.g. 'todo-k69m,#301'). cmd_new parses it with working_refs.parse_refs, fills issues with fill_issues from the TODO catalog when `active().todo.catalog` is set and the file reads (an absent or unreadable catalog leaves the refs as named), and passes them to skeleton, which writes `refs` only when given. A WorkingRefsError becomes a pd.PlanError, so the refusal prints `problem:` and exits 1. Update the module docstring's `new` section (plan.py:21-27) and the write-plan SKILL.md step 1 line with `--refs`.

items.title: /harness:working, the per-branch override
items.action: Copy the planned test file docs/plans/2025/tests/tests/skills/test_working_script.py to tests/skills/test_working_script.py first. New skill plugins/harness/skills/working/: SKILL.md (frontmatter name `working`, argument-hint '-- <todo-id|#issue>... | --clear | --list' (the add-bookmark hint shape, which the guidance-tail contract requires), a body that cites `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/reference/skill_arguments.md` for the split rule and no fenced command carrying $ARGUMENTS; the add-bookmark SKILL.md shape: the first word picks set, clear or list; the reply is the script output verbatim; 'working' joins _INVOCABLE in tests/skills/test_skill_guidance_tail_contract.py) and commands/working.py (add_note.py's shape: sys.path lib insert, argparse with --repo and subcommands set TOKENS..., clear, list; main returns 0 or 1 and prints 'working: <reason>' to stderr). The store is cfg.path(cfg.state_dir) / OVERRIDES_REL. The branch is `git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD`; 'HEAD' (detached) keys as DETACHED. `set` fills issues from the TODO catalog as plan.py new does and prints '<branch>: <format_refs>'; `clear` prints 'cleared <branch>' or 'no override for <branch>'; `list` prints one '<branch>: <format_refs>' line per branch or 'no overrides'. Add the skill to the README skill tables and the harness CHANGELOG-style lists the README keeps.

items.title: working-refs mod: scaffold and pure modules
items.action: Copy the planned test file docs/plans/2025/tests/tests/mods/test_working_refs_contract.py to tests/mods/test_working_refs_contract.py first. New mod plugins/working-refs/ (the band-line layout): .claude-plugin/plugin.json (name working-refs, version 0.1.0, dependencies ['git-status'], types ./types/index.d.ts), .claude-plugin/icon.png (copy band-line's; tests/contract/test_plugin_icons.py), .gitignore (.claude-plugin/types/), tsconfig.json. hooks/hooks.json waits for TASK-5, which writes register.ts. Pure modules, no `$`: hooks/mirror.ts exports OVERRIDES_PATH, LINE_PATH, DETACHED_KEY, DEFAULT_STATE_DIR, DEFAULT_PLANS, PLAN_SUFFIX, PIP_HTML_SUFFIX, BRANCHES_KEY ('branches'), TODO_IDS_KEY ('todo_ids') and ISSUES_KEY ('issues') as `export const NAME = '...'` string literals and STORE_VERSION as the number literal `export const STORE_VERSION = 1` (the contract test reads them with ts_string and ts_number; notes.ts and todo-watch config.ts patterns); overrides.ts and plans.ts read the JSON through those key constants, never a spelled-out key. hooks/config.ts reads state_dir and artifacts.plans from a harness.json text over the mirror defaults (todo-watch readConfig pattern); hooks/plans.ts parses an ActionPlan text into {id, branch, baseBranch, baseCommit, refs, page} (page = the sibling PIP_HTML_SUFFIX file; a plan whose documentation is not that page is skipped, spec Builder's calls) and qualifies(plan, branch, mergeBaseOf, archivedIds): branch match, or baseCommit equal to mergeBaseOf(baseBranch), the merge base the caller resolves by D9, and no archived id (D2, D3); hooks/overrides.ts parses overrides.json (version check against the number STORE_VERSION, branches map; malformed reads as none); hooks/line.ts builds {plans, todoIds, issues} for a branch (the override's refs replace the union of the qualifying plans' refs; plan links are never overridden) and renders it: plain text 'plan 2025 · todo-k69m (301)' or 'plans 2024, 2025 · ...' and the ccstatusline form with each plan number an OSC 8 link to the page's file:/// URL (D8); empty when nothing qualifies and no override is set. types/index.d.ts declares the state atom `working-refs.line` ({branch, plans: [{id, page}], todoIds, issues, text} | null, where text is the plain form, so band-line draws it without a second copy of the format). Unit tests beside each module (*.test.ts, band-line test conventions).

items.title: working-refs mod: hooks, scans and the line file
items.action: plugins/working-refs/hooks/hooks.json ({modules: ['./register.ts']}), hooks/register.ts and hooks/watch.ts. Resolve the project root and harness.json as todo-watch watch.ts does (session cwd, then CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR). The branch comes from git-status's `git` atom. A scan lists the plans folder, reads every *_ActionPlan.json that has a sibling page, resolves the merge base once per distinct base branch by D9 (no fetch: `git rev-parse --verify --quiet origin/<base>^{commit}`; when it exists, `git merge-base --is-ancestor origin/<base> <base>` picks the local branch on exit 0, else origin/<base>; then `git merge-base <tip> HEAD`; a failed call means no merge-base match for that base) and runs `git for-each-ref --format=%(refname:short) refs/tags/archive/plan/` once (archived ids from the tag names), applies qualifies, reads overrides.json, builds the line and stores it in the `line` atom when it changed. Triggers: session.start; a branch change in git-status's snapshot; prompt.submit runs `git rev-parse HEAD` and the tag listing and rescans when HEAD or the archived set moved (spec Builder's calls: rebases); after a Write, Edit or Bash tool call and on prompt.submit, a changed signature of the plans folder (the name and mtime of each *_ActionPlan.json and *_PIP.html, so a plan rewritten in place counts, which the folder's own mtime misses) or a newer mtime of overrides.json (todo-watch checks.ts mtimeOf pattern). Every git call through $.process.run with a timeout, never throwing (git-status status.ts:155 pattern). line.txt holds the ccstatusline form at <state_dir>/working-refs/line.txt, per checkout (cfg.path, never main_worktree): after every scan compare the rendered text with the file's contents (not with the atom, which starts null in each session) and rewrite on any difference, so the session.start scan empties a line another branch or an earlier session left (spec anti-goal). README.md (hooks table, state, files, Checks, Loading). Register the mod: .claude-plugin/marketplace.json entry after band-line; .github/workflows/ci.yml appends plugins/working-refs to the `claude plugin test` loop (line 128), so the mod's tests run in CI; CLAUDE.md 'nine TypeScript mods' naming `working-refs` (S1), and its new-config-key rule names working-refs' hooks/mirror.ts with tests/mods/test_working_refs_contract.py beside session-bookmark's notes.ts; the root README mod tables and install lines. Tests: hooks/watch.test.ts with a world that answers git, fs and state (todo-watch testWorld.ts pattern): a plan on the branch shows; a sibling plan by merge base shows; a lagging local main resolves against origin/main; an archived plan drops on the next prompt; a rebase that moves the merge base rescans; a plan rewritten in place updates the line; an override replaces the refs; line.txt is written, and a stale non-empty line.txt is emptied by the session.start scan when nothing qualifies.

items.title: setup-statusline: the working-refs widget, project level
items.action: Copy the planned test file docs/plans/2025/tests/tests/skills/test_setup_statusline_contract.py to tests/skills/test_setup_statusline_contract.py first. ccstatusline.defaults.json gains a third line holding one custom-command widget (new uuid id, commandPath `node -e "let s='';process.stdin.on('data',d=>s+=d).on('end',()=>{try{const j=JSON.parse(s),r=(j.workspace||{}).project_dir||j.cwd||'.';process.stdout.write(require('fs').readFileSync(require('path').join(r,'.claude/state/harness/working-refs/line.txt'),'utf8'))}catch(e){}})"`, preserveColors true, timeout 1000); the command resolves line.txt against workspace.project_dir (else cwd) of the status JSON ccstatusline pipes to its stdin (D10, value 'ccstatusline custom-command input'), so each worktree session prints its own checkout's line wherever ccstatusline runs; customCommandCacheTtlSeconds stays 0 (S3). SKILL.md: step 4 gains the widget for an existing project file (opt-in: ask with AskUserQuestion, then add only that line); a new step resolves `state_dir` from `<project>/.claude/harness.json` (default .claude/state/harness) and rewrites the '.claude/state/harness' part of commandPath when it differs. The widget is only useful with the working-refs mod; say so. README: the widget row in the Defaults table and the opt-in step. plugin.json 0.2.1 -> 0.3.0.

decisions.question: How the work splits between the mod, the widget and the harness (spec Approaches).

options.summary: Mod renders the line; the ccstatusline widget only prints a file
Mod stores refs; a Python widget renders
No mod; plan.py writes refs and the widget matches each repaint

decisions.rationale: Developer's choice: no code or plugin path in the widget, one file read per repaint.

decisions.question: When does a plan qualify for the current branch (spec Section 2)?

options.summary: plan.branch equals the branch, or plan.base_commit equals git merge-base HEAD <plan.base_branch>
only plan.branch equals the branch

decisions.rationale: Developer: two ways to qualify; every qualifying plan shows its own link.

decisions.question: When does a plan link leave the banner (spec Section 2)?

options.summary: an archive/<stem>/ tag exists for the plan
the plan has no open items

decisions.rationale: Developer: plan.py archive is the trigger; checked by tag since archive writes no file.

decisions.question: Where the ccstatusline widget lives (spec Section 4).

options.summary: the project's .claude/ccstatusline.json, written by setup-statusline
the user's ~/.config/ccstatusline/settings.json

decisions.rationale: Developer: the plans folder and state_dir are per-project config.

decisions.question: Where the automatic refs come from (spec Section 1).

options.summary: a structured refs field on the ActionPlan, set by plan.py new --refs
issue numbers scraped from item prose

decisions.rationale: Developer: a distinct field; prose names issues a plan only mentions.

decisions.question: Which files hold the override and the rendered line (spec Section 2 names one refs.json).

options.summary: overrides.json written only by the harness command; line.txt written only by the mod
one refs.json both sides write

decisions.rationale: Plan-level: one writer per file, so a mod rescan never clobbers an override written between its read and write; the plan matches are recomputed on each scan and need no file.

decisions.question: When a TODO id's catalog issues are filled in (spec Section 1 says when the line is built).

options.summary: at write time, by plan.py new and the working command (Python reads the catalog)
at render time, by the mod reading the catalog

decisions.rationale: Plan-level: the harness already resolves todo.folder and the catalog; the mod then never reads the catalog or copies its config.

decisions.question: How the plan link renders in ccstatusline.

options.summary: an OSC 8 hyperlink, visible text 'plan NNNN', target the page's file:/// URL; widget preserveColors true
the bare page path

decisions.rationale: ccstatusline 2.2.32 keeps escapes when preserveColors is true and draws OSC 8 links itself (renderOsc8Link, its git-pr widget); a live check confirms it on screen (TASK-8).

decisions.question: Which base tip the merge-base clause of D2 compares with (local review I2).

options.summary: the tip plan.py new recorded base_commit against: origin/<base> when it exists and local <base> does not contain it, else <base> (branch_capture.resolve_merge_base, without the fetch)
local <base> only

decisions.rationale: Plan-level: base_commit comes from resolve_merge_base, so the mod must compute the same merge base or a lagging local main never matches in a sibling worktree.

decisions.question: Where the ccstatusline widget resolves line.txt (local review I6).

options.summary: against workspace.project_dir (else cwd) of the status JSON ccstatusline pipes to the command's stdin
relative to the command's working folder

decisions.rationale: Plan-level: ccstatusline spawns the command with no cwd option, so a relative path depends on where ccstatusline itself runs; the stdin payload names the session's project folder in every worktree.

decisions.question: How band-line gets the working line (local review I5).

options.summary: an atom over the working-refs `line` key, declared in band-line's own PluginState; null while working-refs is absent
read <state_dir>/working-refs/line.txt with $.fs

decisions.rationale: Plan-level: the engine's state reads take any declared {plugin, key} and answer undefined for a key nobody set; only writes are limited to the owner (value 'cross-mod state read'). The atom also redraws on change, which a file read does not.
